scope: TRAIN-only O1 implementation/baseline operational evaluation plus separate five-fold continuation of the two surviving clip candidates. No combined new mechanisms, temporal retraining, reserved designs, production cutover or retrospective label/threshold changes.

confirmation.reuse: Reuse original ordinary-classification warning and full-covariance own-feature models for folds0/1, with their exact partitions/fingerprints. Fit folds2/3/4 only using the unchanged inner selection, objective, optimizer, regularization, four views and spatial fitting settings.
confirmation.warning: 28 control/products inputs,32/16 ordinary classification head, selected on inner design BCE,300 candidate epochs; original seed42 OOF/reference margin members remain frozen. One learned score supports all calibration budgets.
confirmation.covariance: Original independent4096-sample synthetic quiet model and5% diagonal shrinkage; weighted pole identification, original-channel modal coefficients. Only full covariance survives; unchanged own-feature107/174 MLPs alpha1 maxiter20000/maxfun400000. Matched-seed archived unweighted models retained.
confirmation.reporting: All37 conditions and fresh/replication families, nominal5% primary/1% secondary, actual held false flags, stable/unstable positive-error tails, clean accuracy and far-stable pessimism. Report five-fold continuation separately from initial two-fold screen. Mixed seeds are not independent repeated-seed confirmation.

O1.design_partition: Shuffle77 original TRAIN designs seed1747: first floor(.6*N) fit, next floor(.1*N) policy, next ceil(.1*N) calibration, remainder held. All forcing/noise/initial-condition trajectories grouped. Fit baseline107/174 only on fit-design clip views; no archived model seeing trajectory-held designs.
O1.baseline: Unchanged50/50 spatial blend; no new warning/covariance integration in O1 baseline. Legacy clip-calibrated policies retained as comparators, operational thresholds calibrated on whole benign trajectories.
O1.profiles: All five declared45/20s profiles; all3 initial-condition replicates.
O1.physics: Original nominal design solver matrices and stored nominal flutter boundary. Fixed32-dimensional structural mass-normalized ROM, validated against full-order response/poles; no adaptive per-window basis, stitched clips, state reset or modal growth clamp. Fixed-speed matrix exponential propagation and exponential-midpoint velocity integration; step halving/full-order response comparisons mandatory. Failed reduction or bandwidth audits remain explicit acquisition limitations, not dropped designs.
O1.integration: Simulation coefficient step10ms, output sampling1000Hz; finer5ms validation. Forcing uses fixed-duration transverse-load pulses, not fresh randomized clips. Numerical overflow/dynamic-range termination marks remaining acquisition unavailable, never fabricates capped linear state.
O1.acquisition: Fixed512-sample trailing windows updated every100ms; one fixed per-trajectory leading51-sample calibration; physical-noise amplitude from leading clean calibration only. Overlapping windows share the continuous measured sample stream. No future waveform maximum/RMS normalization. Dropout remains missing, not imputed safe.
O1.bandwidth: Audit initial retained8 full-order response poles across the supported speed range against400Hz. Report unsupported acquisition separately; this audit is simulator/acquisition qualification, not a model truth input. Any ROM response disagreement prevents an operational fidelity claim.
O1.alarms: Five consecutive available negatives clear an episode; unavailable updates neither clear nor imply safe. Compute delivery timestamps with observed inference wall time, no supplied communication/intervention time.
O1.calibration: Prospective episode budgets0.1/1/10/100 per benign operating hour. Candidate threshold family from policy safe-dwell score quantiles. On disjoint calibration safe dwells, choose lowest candidate satisfying each acquisition-family empirical episode rate; add calibration-maximum-plus-nextafter as declared zero-observed-nuisance policy if needed, explicitly report degenerate/no-warning behavior. No population guarantee from short benign exposure.
O1.metrics: Held-design timely crossing misses for horizons0.5/1/2/5s, crossing-relative delivered lead, safe/near/retreat alarm episodes/hour, chatter, unavailable duration, false-safe during supercritical operation, stable/unstable margin tails, complete inference p95/p99/max/deadline misses. Physical harmful-response/intervention/communication acceptance remains unspecified; report sensitivity rather than invent it.

verification: Keep meaningful deterministic regression tests for continuous-state propagation, causal prefix normalization/noise, alarm unavailable/clear/rearm transitions and event timeliness. Actual plate trajectory and saved-model waveform smoke, five-fold calibration replay and legacy endpoint recomputation after implementation changes.
limits: Simulated quasi-steady piston theory, nominal structures only in O1; synthetic sensor stresses, not hardware PSD validation. Repeated exploratory TRAIN use, dependent windows and clips, no blind confirmation or deployment approval. O1 quality/coverage failures must be visible.
